name: Schemas
author: Notible
description: Saved recipes for kinds of items: a title pattern with dates and a running number, default properties and tags. Build one once and attach it to any number of projects, each with its own counter.
guide:
A **schema** fills in new items of one kind for you: a title pattern, properties and tags.

## Build one

Open **Schemas** in the sidebar. Your schemas are on the left; click one to edit it, or **New schema**. Pick the kind of item (task, note, …) and a title pattern:

- `{yyyy}`, `{mm}`, `{dd}`: today's date
- `{counter:3}`: a running number, padded to 3 digits (**Number width** changes the padding)

For example `FV/{counter:3}/{mm}/{yyyy}` gives `FV/001/10/2026`. The counter can restart every year or every month. Add default properties (`status = doing`) and tags. The preview shows the next title.

## Attach it to projects

Open a project (or a folder or space) and its **Schemas** tab. **Attach schema** links an existing schema to it; **New schema** builds one and attaches it when you save; **Detach** unlinks it. Build a schema once and attach it to as many projects as you like: each project counts on its own, so an Invoice schema attached to two projects gives `FV/001`, `FV/002`… in each of them.

A schema that isn't attached anywhere applies everywhere, with one counter of its own. Inside a project, a schema attached there wins over one that applies everywhere.

## Use it

- **+ → your schema's name** creates an item already filled in. Inside a project it uses that project's counter.
- A new item of that kind that still has its default title ("New task") is filled in too.

## Numbers

The next number is the highest one already used + 1. Two computers working offline can give out the same number; after they sync, Notible tells you so you can rename one. Numbers can have gaps: a deleted item's number is not given out again. Detaching and attaching again continues the numbering. Don't rely on this for legally gapless invoice series.
